title: Tool Tiers
subtitle: Bits, chains and frames
text:
The bit decides what a drill can mine, the frame how fast.

The standard bit mines up to diamond ore. Obsidian, crying obsidian, ancient debris and other netherite level blocks throw white-hot sparks and do not break.

A Diamond Drill Bit mines them. With a steel frame at full speed; with an iron frame at 40%, against a steel frame's 125%.
caption: Drill and chainsaw

steps.text: A steel Chainsaw with a Diamond-Tipped Chain fells a whole natural tree, top down, using 50 FE per log. The logs drop where they stood. Sneak to cut one log; built log walls are left alone.
